MocoAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: In MOCO, open your profile's Integrations tab and copy the API key. Enter the account subdomain from your MOCO URL, such as mycompany from https://mycompany.mocoapp.com. An account API key from Settings > Extensions > API & Webhooks also works; writes require full access. Requests use the key's permissions and user identity.
